name: KromiumCustomScheme
summary: Configuration for registering a custom protocol scheme with the underlying Chromium engine.
declaration:
data class KromiumCustomScheme @JvmOverloads constructor(
    val schemeName: String,
    val isStandard: Boolean = true,
    val isLocal: Boolean = true,
    val isDisplayIsolated: Boolean = false,
    val isSecure: Boolean = true,
    val isCorsEnabled: Boolean = true,
    val isCspBypassing: Boolean = false,
    val isFetchEnabled: Boolean = true
)

constructors.signature: KromiumCustomScheme(schemeName: String, isStandard: Boolean = true, isLocal: Boolean = true, isDisplayIsolated: Boolean = false, isSecure: Boolean = true, isCorsEnabled: Boolean = true, isCspBypassing: Boolean = false, isFetchEnabled: Boolean = true)
constructors.description: Constructs a custom protocol scheme registration configuration.

parameters.name: schemeName
parameters.description: The name of the custom protocol scheme (e.g. 'app').

parameters.name: isStandard
parameters.description: If true, the scheme will be treated as a standard scheme with authority/host component.

parameters.name: isLocal
parameters.description: If true, the scheme will be treated as local, similar to file://.

parameters.name: isDisplayIsolated
parameters.description: If true, the scheme can only be displayed from other origins with the same scheme.

parameters.name: isSecure
parameters.description: If true, treated as secure (HTTPS-equivalent: Web Crypto, Service Workers, Storage).

parameters.name: isCorsEnabled
parameters.description: If true, cross-origin requests (CORS) from/to this scheme are permitted.

parameters.name: isCspBypassing
parameters.description: If true, Content Security Policy enforcements are bypassed.

parameters.name: isFetchEnabled
parameters.description: If true, the Fetch API is allowed for this scheme.

properties.name: schemeName
properties.description: The name of the custom protocol scheme.

properties.name: isStandard
properties.description: If true, treated as a standard scheme with authority/host component.

properties.name: isLocal
properties.description: If true, treated as local, similar to file://.

properties.name: isDisplayIsolated
properties.description: If true, can only be displayed from other origins with the same scheme.

properties.name: isCorsEnabled
properties.description: If true, CORS from/to this scheme are permitted.

properties.name: isCspBypassing
properties.description: If true, CSP enforcements are bypassed.

properties.name: isFetchEnabled
properties.description: If true, Fetch API is allowed for this scheme.

companionMethods.name: secure
companionMethods.description: Creates a secure, local custom scheme with CORS and standard URL handling enabled.

companionMethods.name: standard
companionMethods.description: Creates a standard custom scheme without local origin isolation.
